translationRepairs: When he was about to go home, the tribal elders of the barbarians all waved tears as they saw him off.
When he was about to go home, the tribal elders of the frontier peoples all wept as they saw him off.
揮涕 is weeping/wiping tears, not 'waved tears'; 蠻夷 here are the frontier tribal communities under pacification.
When Jiande was defeated, Taizong summoned him and appointed him legal adjutant of the Prince of Qin's mansion.
When Jiande was pacified, Taizong summoned him and appointed him legal adjutant of the Prince of Qin's household.
法曹參軍 is the legal adjutant of the Qin princely household; 曹參 is not the Han minister Cao Shen.
Xue Dading came from Fenyang in Pu Prefecture and was a grandson of Duke Boping Shan, who had been tutor to the Zhou crown prince.
Xue Dading came from Fenyang in Pu Prefecture and was a grandson of Shan, Duke of Boping, who had been junior tutor to the Zhou crown prince.
博平公善 is Shan, Duke of Boping; 'Duke Boping Shan' misorders the title and personal name.
則天 is Empress Wu (Zetian). 然之 means assented/agreed.
